title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Learned to Kick
moral: Making mistakes is how we get better at the things we love.

pages.content: {{NAME}} went to the park to practise soccer. He was all on his own. Then he saw a big silver robot standing by the goal. The robot had round blue eyes and springy legs. It was holding a soccer ball. It looked very hopeful.

pages.content: The robot tried to kick the ball. Its foot went too high. The ball spun sideways into a bush. The robot looked down at its feet. It beeped a sad sound. {{NAME}} ran to get the ball. "It is okay," he said. "Let us try again."

pages.content: {{NAME}} showed the robot how to swing its leg. Slowly, then faster. The robot tried again. Swing, kick! The ball flew straight and fast. It went right into the net. Clang! The robot jumped up and down and beeped with joy.
